body.name: Finite-grid support program
body.construction: \(h_m(c)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\max_f\sum_{i,j}c^x_{ij}f^x_{ij}\), where the maximization uses the chain flow; equivalently minimize \(\sum_i\alpha_i d_x(i)+\sum_j\beta_j\zeta_x(j)+\sum_{k,j}\lambda_{kj}\kappa^x_{kj}\) subject to \(\alpha_i+\beta_j+\sum_{k<i}\lambda_{kj}\ge c^x_{ij}\) and \(\lambda_{kj}\ge0\).
